Export names (only the names) and export numbers of Windows system DLLs,
read from Windows Vista SP2 and Windows 7 SP1 installations (x86 and x64)
with tools/peexp.py and tools/ordinals.py, and from Windows 8 RTM
(6.2.9200, install.wim of the x64 DVD: System32 and SysWOW64) with
tools/addwinexports.py. They tell tools/gen.py which names each VistaExt
companion must forward, and on which Windows a name exists. Windows 8.1 runs
the Windows 8 build, so only what 8.0 has is forwarded. No Microsoft code
is included.

dxgi.txt, dnsapi.txt, winhttp.txt and userenv.txt (added November 2026) were
read from Vista SP2 and 7 SP1 installations with the updates VistaExt's setup
asks for (Vista's Platform Update, which gives dxgi CreateDXGIFactory1) and
from Windows 8 RTM, with tools/addwinexports.py. A name only an update adds
is forwarded like any other: without the update it fails exactly as
Windows' own DLL would.
